notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard MOM transportation-type change requests. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM request interactions, HLAattributeHandleList, HLAunicodeString, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, application FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/interaction/parameter configuration. It verifies request confirmation callbacks, ordinary attribute and interaction delivery, per-federate transportation isolation, service reporting, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard MOM transportation-type change requests and FederateAmbassador confirmation callbacks with ordinary object and interaction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, transportation, object-management, interaction, and data-element declarations
